cohort: The study included 283 pediatric patients conceived via assisted reproductive techniques, aged 18 months and older, born between January 2017 and December 2022 at King Khalid University Hospital in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
finding: The primary neurological sequela identified was speech disorder (6.4%), with behavioral issues (2.8%) and motor delays (1.8%) also reported; neurological complications were significantly associated with very preterm status, low birth weight, and NICU admission.
followup_time: Mean age of 4.1 years (ranging from 18 months to approximately 6 years)
